schema.description: The caller's number in the SAME form you sent to get_profile: 12 digits beginning with 91, digits only, no plus sign - e.g. 919876543210. Build it by FORMAT, not by adding: if ${contact_phone} is already 12 digits starting with 91 (outbound calls), send it UNCHANGED and never add another 91; if it is 10 digits (inbound calls), put 91 in front. A number starting 9191 is always wrong - the backend finds users by phone, so a doubled prefix silently creates a separate phantom user.
